summary: Robert Miller, owner of Summit Peak Plumbing, agreed to review a pre-built website demo after Alex from Apex AI Web Studio addressed his concerns about time and cost, offering a flat $750 package.
transcript:
ALEX: Good morning, Robert. My name is Alex, and I'm a sales consultant with Apex AI Web Studio. I was doing some research on local businesses in Denver and came across Summit Peak Plumbing. You've got fantastic 4.7-star reviews, which is really impressive! I also noticed your current website might not be fully showcasing that excellence, so we actually took the liberty of building a quick, modern demo site specifically for Summit Peak Plumbing to show you what's possible.
OWNER: Hmm, okay. Robert Miller here. Thanks for the compliment, but I'm pretty swamped today, Alex. What exactly is this about, and how much is this 'demo' going to cost me? I get calls like this all the time.
ALEX: Absolutely, Robert, I understand you're busy, and I appreciate you taking my call. To answer your questions: we found you through online searches, looking for highly-rated local businesses with potential for a website refresh. The demo itself is completely free, no obligation whatsoever. Our goal is just to show you what a modern, mobile-friendly site could look like for Summit Peak Plumbing. If you like it, our full package for a site like this is a flat $750, all-inclusive. It's designed to be quick and affordable for busy owners like yourself. I can send you the link right now, it's live at http://localhost:3030/demos/summit-peak-plumbing/index.html.
OWNER: A flat $750, huh? That's... surprisingly reasonable. Okay, Alex, I'm intrigued. Send me that link. I can't promise to look at it right this second, but I'll definitely take a look later this afternoon when things calm down. What's the best way to get that link?
